title: 4UR4 Trendline Golden Fixture — expected.json
description: Machine-validated shape for a single golden-fixture expected-output document. This describes TEST DATA / RESEARCH EVIDENCE (not product implementation) under the GOV-015 build-freeze. Geometry fields are pinned to 6 significant figures so a future engine can be checked for exact reproduction of the approved trendline-specification.md definitions.

purpose.description: One-sentence statement of what spec behaviour this fixture locks.

category.description: Coverage category (e.g. 'normal valid', 'wick-only crossing', 'stock split edge case').

spec_refs.description: List of trendline/confidence spec sections and decisions used, e.g. ['§8','D-TL-04'].

timestamp_kind.description: Whether input.csv timestamp column is an ordinal index t or a synthetic ISO date.

price_field_for_geometry.description: y[t]=ln(H[t]); geometry always uses the bar high (§3).

params.description: Named, versioned config used to derive the expected values (§20).

eps_break.description: Breakout tolerance in log units (§13.5). ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT LOCKED (HD-03).

eps_break_locked.description: MUST be false — eps_break is versioned/backtestable, never locked (HD-03, §13.5).

eps_break_note.description: Human note reaffirming eps_break is illustrative, not locked (HD-03).

min_formation_bars.description: Minimum available history before a line may become ACTIVE (§21.3 F1, D-TL-12). A first-class versioned parameter, INDEPENDENT of the pivot window k; it replaces the pivot-derived 2k+2 formulation.

min_ath_age_bars.description: Minimum number of bars that must separate the anchor A from the last available bar before a line may become ACTIVE (§21.3 F2, D-TL-12). Constrains the ANCHOR only — never the candidacy of any B (HD-11, HD-12 rule 6). Independent of k; it replaces the pivot-derived k-recency window.

formation_params_note.description: Human note recording that the formation gates are k-independent, versioned and backtestable (D-TL-12).

tolerance_version.description: Version tag for the tolerance set used (traceability, §20).

expected_ath_anchor.description: Anchor A=(tA,HA); null when no geometry is produced (invalid input / no ATH).

t.description: Null when no B* exists; `reason` then explains why.

H.description: Null when no B* exists; `reason` then explains why.

reason.description: Why this B* was selected, or — when t/H are null — why none was.

expected_second_anchor.description: Selected second anchor B*=(tB,HB) per §6/§8; null with reason when none.

expected_log_slope.description: m=(yB−yA)/(tB−tA) to 6 significant figures (§7); null when no line.

expected_intercept.description: b=yA−m·tA to 6 significant figures (§7); null when no line.

expected_line_values.description: Map of relevant bar index -> {y_hat, line} to 6 sig figs, where line=exp(y_hat).

from.description: State at the START of this transition (§11). Must equal the previous transition's `to` — the list is continuous, and that continuity is asserted by `tools/fixture-replay.mjs --all` (§21.6 rule 3). Continuity is not edge legality: the check does not reject an edge §11 omits.

reason_code.description: Named reason code (§10, §11, §18). Closed set: a code outside it is a schema error, not a new behaviour.

expected_final_state.description: Terminal state of the series (§11). Closed set — WICK_BREAK is NOT a state: §11 draws it as an ACTIVE -> ACTIVE edge recorded by a reason code, so a wick-break fixture ends ACTIVE.

breakout_bar.description: First qualifying close bar (§13); HD-03 confirmed_bar==breakout_bar.

expected_reason_codes.description: Set of every reason code emitted for this fixture.

rejection_rationale.description: Why each competing outcome is rejected, with the numeric comparison.

geometry_check.description: Restated arithmetic so an independent verifier can confirm every number by hand.

causal_record.description: As-of-time (§21 / HD-12 / D-TL-11) evidence block, emitted by tools/fixture-replay.mjs: the formation-gate trace with F1/F2/F3 evaluated independently, the as-of-time candidate set at the formation bar, the active B* and line value before every event bar, each event with its margin, every pre-breakout re-selection, the frozen event line, the later non-retroactive challengers, the eps_break robustness sweep, and a DESCRIPTIVE pivot context. Every number is derived only from bars strictly earlier than the bar it judges.
